name: Minimum
description: Lightweight performance mod. Skips particle draws that render nothing, caps particle spam in heavy levels, shows your real FPS, can cut input lag, and unlocks FPS on phones. Tap the logo in the pause menu for quick toggles. Visual only - gameplay, physics and timing are never touched.

mod-enabled.name: Enable Minimum
mod-enabled.description: Master switch. Turn it off to compare with and without the mod (no restart needed).

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Quick profile for the particle and background settings. Balanced: cap 256. Performance: cap 128. Extreme: cap 48, thin effects. Custom: use the individual settings below. Re-enter the level after changing the cap.

pause-button-corner.name: Pause Menu Button
pause-button-corner.description: Where the Minimum logo button sits in the pause menu. If another button is in the way it moves to the nearest free spot by itself. Hidden removes it (open Minimum from the Geode mod list instead).

toggle-mod-key.name: Hotkey: Toggle Minimum
toggle-mod-key.description: Turns Minimum on or off instantly, so you can compare with and without it.

toggle-stats-key.name: Hotkey: Toggle Stats Line
toggle-stats-key.description: Shows or hides the stats line.

low-latency.name: Low Latency Mode
low-latency.description: Trims the queue of frames the graphics driver keeps in flight, so taps and clicks reach the screen sooner. The CPU waits for the GPU every frame, so on a GPU limited device it can LOWER your FPS. Off by default. If it costs you frames, Minimum switches it off by itself for a while.

fps-unlock.name: Unlock FPS
fps-unlock.description: Asks the game for frames faster than 60. On a 60 Hz screen nothing changes; on a 90/120 Hz screen the game can finally use it. Off by default.

fps-limit.name: FPS Limit
fps-limit.description: The frame rate to ask for when Unlock FPS is on. Set it to your screen's refresh rate.

skip-idle-particles.name: Skip Idle Particle Draws
skip-idle-particles.description: Do not issue a draw call for particle systems that have no live particles. No visual change.

cap-particles.name: Cap Particle Pool Size
cap-particles.description: Limits how many particles one particle system can hold. Only affects systems created after the change, so re-enter the level. Lower cap = more FPS in particle-heavy levels, thinner effects.

particle-cap.name: Particle Cap
particle-cap.description: Max particles per system. 128 keeps normal effects intact and trims extreme particle spam. 32 is aggressive.

adaptive-cap.name: Adaptive Particle Cap (experimental)
adaptive-cap.description: If the game keeps missing Target FPS, the particle cap is lowered step by step (down to 1/8) and raised again once the game is smooth. Visual only. Off by default.

adaptive-target-fps.name: Adaptive Target FPS
adaptive-target-fps.description: The frame rate you want to hold. Set it to your screen refresh rate (60, 90, 120, 144...). Slow = a frame longer than 1.5x this.

timer-resolution.name: 1 ms Timer Resolution
timer-resolution.description: Asks Windows for 1 ms timer wakeups instead of ~15.6 ms. Reduces uneven frame pacing when the game waits for the next frame. Slightly higher idle power use.

disable-power-throttling.name: Disable Power Throttling
disable-power-throttling.description: Opts the game out of Windows efficiency mode (EcoQoS) so it is not moved to slow cores or low clocks. Useful on laptops and Windows 11.

process-priority.name: Process Priority
process-priority.description: Above Normal is safe. High can starve OBS or Discord. Applied immediately, no restart needed.

background-throttle.name: Throttle Drawing In Background
background-throttle.description: While the game window is not focused, draw at Background FPS. Game logic and audio keep running normally. Windows only. Turn off if you record the game with OBS window capture while it is unfocused.

background-fps.name: Background FPS
background-fps.description: Draw rate while the game window is not focused.

background-volume.name: Lower Volume When Tabbed Out
background-volume.description: Drops music and SFX when the window loses focus so other audio is clearer.

draw-divide.name: Draw Divide
draw-divide.description: OFF by default. Draws at Visual FPS while game logic keeps running at the full frame rate. Only useful if your FPS is higher than your screen refresh rate (FPS bypass / uncapped). Do NOT use together with the mat.draw-divide mod.

visual-fps.name: Visual FPS
visual-fps.description: Draw rate when Draw Divide is on. Set it to your monitor refresh rate (60, 144, 240).

spike-logger.name: Frame Spike Logger
spike-logger.description: Writes every frame that takes longer than the threshold to the Geode log, with the player x position and how many particle systems were created during that frame. Look for lines containing 'Frame spike' in the files in geode/logs (or in the Geode console).

spike-threshold-ms.name: Spike Threshold (ms)
spike-threshold-ms.description: A frame longer than this counts as a spike. 40 ms = a visible stutter at 60 FPS. Lower it if you run 240 FPS and want to catch smaller hitches.

show-stats.name: Show FPS Counter
show-stats.description: Shows the real FPS in a corner of the screen. Green is smooth, yellow so-so, red bad. Shows (background) while the game is throttled because the window is not focused.

hud-detail.name: Stats Detail
hud-detail.description: Compact shows only the FPS. Detailed also shows logic updates per second, worst frame, spikes and particle counters.

hud-corner.name: Stats Corner
hud-corner.description: Where the stats line is drawn.

fast-alt-tab.name: Fast Alt Tab
fast-alt-tab.description: Skips the game save that happens when the window loses focus, so alt-tab does not stutter. Saving on level exit and on closing the game is untouched. Not available on Android and iOS on purpose: the OS can close the app right after it goes to the background.
